title: Bus Lanes
subtitle: 「巴士專用線／巴士優先車道」，要分清『車道』、『專用道路』和『巴士路線』。
description: 「巴士專用線／巴士優先車道」，要分清『車道』、『專用道路』和『巴士路線』。

words.meaning: 巴士專用線；只供巴士行駛的車道
words.example: The city introduced a bus-only lane on the main avenue.
words.exampleZh: 市政府在主要大道設置巴士專用線。

exercises.original: The council introduced new bus lanes on the main avenue.
exercises.zh: 議會在主要大道增設巴士專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The council introduced new bus-only lanes on the main avenue.

options.explanation: 原句談的是道路上給巴士專用的車道，語義和 bus lanes 最直接。
route 指服務行走路線，不是道路上的專用車道。
是上落客地點，不是行車線。
專供單車使用，車種不同。
HOV 是高載客車輛概念，而且 route 也不是 lane。
指較大的交通走廊範圍，不是一條具體車道。

exercises.original: Cars are not allowed to use the bus lane during peak hours.
exercises.zh: 繁忙時間私家車不得使用巴士專用線。
exercises.upgrade: Cars are not allowed to use the bus-only lane during peak hours.

options.explanation: 可能容許符合載客要求的私家車，和 cars are not allowed 的巴士專用限制不同。
明確表示一般私家車不得進入，最吻合。
路肩不是一般意義上的巴士專用車道。

exercises.original: The new bus lane is separated from general traffic by a solid line.
exercises.zh: 新的巴士專用線以實線與一般車流分隔。
exercises.upgrade: The new bus-only lane is separated from general traffic by a solid line.

options.explanation: 範圍太大，不能描述一條由實線分隔的 lane。
和 general traffic 分隔的專用巴士車道最符合。
路線不是道路標線分隔的車道。
路肩不是這裡的正式巴士線。

words.meaning: 專用巴士線；專設巴士車道
words.example: The transport plan proposes a dedicated bus lane along the corridor.
words.exampleZh: 交通規劃建議沿該走廊設置專用巴士線。

exercises.original: The transport plan proposes bus lanes along the entire corridor.
exercises.zh: 交通規劃建議沿整條走廊設置專用巴士線。
exercises.upgrade: The transport plan proposes dedicated bus lanes along the entire corridor.

options.explanation: 交通規劃中專門分配給巴士的車道，完全吻合。
route 指服務走向，不是道路上的 lane；這是你提供的相關詞，但不是直接同義詞。
是的士行車路線，不是巴士專用車道。
路肩本身不是專用巴士線。

exercises.original: The city plans to build two new bus lanes next year.
exercises.zh: 市政府計劃明年興建兩條新的專用巴士線。
exercises.upgrade: The city plans to build two new dedicated bus lanes next year.

options.explanation: corridor 是較大的道路／交通走廊，不等於兩條具體車道。
build two lanes 的數量和基建語境完全合適。
路線不能用 build two lanes 的同一方式理解。
可能供多類高載客車輛使用。

exercises.original: Buses will travel in a separate bus lane through the busiest section.
exercises.zh: 巴士會在最繁忙的一段使用獨立專用線。
exercises.upgrade: Buses will travel in a separate dedicated bus lane through the busiest section.

options.explanation: 太廣，不能對應 separate lane。
說明巴士去哪裡，不是使用哪條車道。
separate + buses + lane 清楚表示專設巴士車道。
若真是路肩需明確說 shoulder-running；原句沒有。

words.meaning: 巴士專用車道；排他性巴士線
words.example: Buses travel in an exclusive bus lane during the busiest section of the route.
words.exampleZh: 巴士在路線最繁忙的一段使用專用巴士車道。

exercises.original: General traffic is excluded from the bus lane in the city centre.
exercises.zh: 市中心巴士專用線禁止一般車輛駛入。
exercises.upgrade: General traffic is excluded from the exclusive bus lane in the city centre.

options.explanation: general traffic is excluded 正是 exclusive 的核心含義。
一般符合載客條件的車輛可能仍可使用。
不表示排除一般車流的道路空間。

exercises.original: The busiest section has a bus lane that no private cars may enter.
exercises.zh: 最繁忙路段有一條私家車不得進入的巴士專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The busiest section has an exclusive bus lane that no private cars may enter.

options.explanation: 也可有車輛限制，但 exclusive 更直接對應 no private cars may enter。
強調私家車被排除，語義最精準。
某些私家車可能符合 HOV 規定。

exercises.original: The scheme gives buses their own lane, completely separated from ordinary traffic.
exercises.zh: 計劃讓巴士使用完全與一般交通分隔的專用車道。
exercises.upgrade: The scheme gives buses an exclusive bus lane, completely separated from ordinary traffic.

options.explanation: 不等於單一 lane，而且可能包含多種設施。
own lane + completely separated 強烈支持 exclusive。
路線不是專用道路空間。

words.meaning: 預留巴士線；巴士專用車道
words.example: The inside lane is reserved for buses during the morning peak.
words.exampleZh: 內線在早上繁忙時間預留給巴士使用。

exercises.original: The lane is a bus lane from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m. on weekdays.
exercises.zh: 該車道平日早上七時至十時預留給巴士使用。
exercises.upgrade: The lane is a reserved bus lane from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m. on weekdays.

options.explanation: 指定時段保留給巴士，正是 reserved 的典型用法。
busway 通常是更完整、獨立的專用道路，和單一時段車線不同。

exercises.original: During the morning peak, the left lane is kept for buses.
exercises.zh: 早上繁忙時間左線預留給巴士。
exercises.upgrade: During the morning peak, the left lane is reserved for buses.

options.explanation: 只說巴士有使用，沒有表示其他車輛受限制。
kept for buses 的正式、直接改寫。

exercises.original: The road markings show that this bus lane operates only at certain times.
exercises.zh: 道路標記顯示這條巴士線只在指定時間生效。
exercises.upgrade: The road markings show that this reserved bus lane operates only at certain times.

options.explanation: 不會以 road markings 形成一條時段車線。
operates only at certain times 與正式預留時段完全吻合。

words.meaning: 巴士優先線；巴士優先車道
words.example: A bus-priority lane was added to reduce delays during rush hour.
words.exampleZh: 道路增設巴士優先線，以減少繁忙時間的延誤。

exercises.original: The council added a bus lane to reduce delays at rush hour.
exercises.zh: 議會增設巴士優先線，以減少繁忙時間延誤。
exercises.upgrade: The council added a bus-priority lane to reduce delays at rush hour.

options.explanation: reduce delays 是典型巴士優先措施目的。
改變路線不等於給巴士道路優先權。
不會本身解決整段道路延誤。
只是道路構造部分，未必有巴士優先。

exercises.original: The new lane gives buses priority over ordinary traffic near the junction.
exercises.zh: 新車道讓巴士在路口附近優先於一般車流。
exercises.upgrade: The new bus-priority lane gives buses priority over ordinary traffic near the junction.

options.explanation: 也可優先，但題目沒有說完全排除一般車輛，只強調 priority。
gives buses priority 是直接定義線索。
優先對象不是只限巴士。

exercises.original: The scheme uses a bus lane to help buses move through congestion faster.
exercises.zh: 計劃利用巴士優先線讓巴士更快穿過擠塞路段。
exercises.upgrade: The scheme uses a bus-priority lane to help buses move through congestion faster.

options.explanation: 可能也有效，但題目只說 buses，且重點是 priority。
faster through congestion 是最典型功能。

words.meaning: 公共交通專用線；運輸專用車道
words.example: The downtown street includes a transit-only lane for buses.
words.exampleZh: 市中心街道設有供巴士使用的公共交通專用線。

exercises.original: The downtown bus lane is also used by streetcars.
exercises.zh: 市中心的公共交通專用線亦供電車使用。
exercises.upgrade: The downtown transit-only lane is also used by streetcars.

options.explanation: buses + streetcars 都屬公共交通，因此比 bus-only 更準確。
題目明說 streetcars 也可使用，所以 only buses 不成立。

exercises.original: Only public-transit vehicles may use this lane.
exercises.zh: 只有公共交通車輛可使用此車道。
exercises.upgrade: This is a transit-only lane.

options.explanation: HOV 可包括多人共乘私家車，不限公共交通。
only public-transit vehicles 是直接定義。

exercises.original: The project converts one traffic lane into a lane for buses and other transit vehicles.
exercises.zh: 項目把一條普通車線改成供巴士及其他公共交通工具使用的專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The project converts one traffic lane into a transit-only lane.

options.explanation: 太廣，並不表示只供公共交通。
buses and other transit vehicles 正是關鍵。

words.example: The road has a public-transport lane beside the central divider.
words.exampleZh: 道路中央分隔帶旁設有公共交通專用線。

exercises.original: The street has a lane reserved for buses and permitted public-transport vehicles.
exercises.zh: 街道設有供巴士及獲准公共交通車輛使用的專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The street has a public-transport lane reserved for buses and permitted public-transport vehicles.

options.explanation: 不只一種公共交通車輛可使用，這個上位表達最穩妥。
題目明說還有其他 permitted public-transport vehicles。
HOV 是按載客量，不是公共交通身份。

exercises.original: The central lane is set aside for public transport.
exercises.zh: 中央車道預留給公共交通工具。
exercises.upgrade: The central lane is a public-transport lane.

options.explanation: corridor 範圍大於一條 central lane。
set aside for public transport 直接對應。

exercises.original: The proposal creates a new lane for buses and other authorised transit services.
exercises.zh: 建議增設供巴士及其他獲授權公共交通服務使用的車道。
exercises.upgrade: The proposal creates a new public-transport lane.

options.explanation: 因為還有 other authorised transit services，所以太窄。
涵蓋多類公共交通，最合適。

words.example: The new busway allows buses to avoid the most congested streets.
words.exampleZh: 新的巴士專用道路讓巴士避開最擠塞的街道。

exercises.original: The city built a separated bus lane system that avoids mixed traffic.
exercises.zh: 城市興建與一般交通分隔的巴士專用道路系統。
exercises.upgrade: The city built a busway that avoids mixed traffic.

options.explanation: separated system + avoids mixed traffic 表示較完整獨立的巴士專用道路。
路線可仍與一般車流混行，沒有分隔設施含義。
並非只供巴士，也不一定形成完整系統。
太廣，可能包括多類設施。

exercises.original: Buses use a separate roadway beside the motorway.
exercises.zh: 巴士使用高速公路旁的獨立巴士專用道。
exercises.upgrade: Buses use a busway beside the motorway.

options.explanation: 若是一般道路中的一條車道可以，但 separate roadway 更像 busway。
separate roadway 是關鍵，表示整段巴士專用道路。
高速公路路肩不是同一概念。

exercises.original: The rapid bus service runs along its own separated road for five kilometres.
exercises.zh: 快速巴士服務有五公里行駛在獨立專用道路上。
exercises.upgrade: The rapid bus service runs along a busway for five kilometres.

options.explanation: 可能包含這段道路，但不等同 own separated road 本身。
own separated road for five kilometres 是典型 busway。

words.meaning: 專用巴士道；獨立巴士專用道路
words.example: The project includes a dedicated busway through the city centre.
words.exampleZh: 項目包括一條穿過市中心的專用巴士道。

exercises.original: The BRT project includes a fully separated bus lane through the city centre.
exercises.zh: 巴士快速交通項目包括穿過市中心的完全分隔式巴士專用道。
exercises.upgrade: The BRT project includes a dedicated busway through the city centre.

options.explanation: BRT + fully separated + through corridor 正是專用巴士道。
route 是服務線路，不描述 fully separated road infrastructure。

exercises.original: The scheme gives buses a continuous separated right of way.
exercises.zh: 計劃為巴士提供連續而分隔的專用路權。
exercises.upgrade: The scheme gives buses a dedicated busway.

options.explanation: 若只是一條普通道路車線可用，但 continuous separated right of way 更像 busway。
持續獨立路權是 dedicated busway 的核心。

exercises.original: The buses leave ordinary traffic and enter a separate bus road.
exercises.zh: 巴士離開一般車流後駛入獨立巴士專用道路。
exercises.upgrade: The buses leave ordinary traffic and enter a dedicated busway.

options.explanation: 可能仍位於同一一般道路內，未必是 separate bus road。
separate bus road 完全吻合。

words.example: The buses use a segregated BRT lane through the central district.
words.exampleZh: 巴士快速交通車輛在中央地區使用分隔式專用線。

exercises.original: The rapid-transit buses use their own lane through the busiest section.
exercises.zh: 巴士快速交通車輛在最繁忙路段使用專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The rapid-transit buses use a dedicated BRT lane through the busiest section.

options.explanation: rapid-transit buses 明確指出 Bus Rapid Transit 系統，專用 BRT lane 最精準。

exercises.original: The new Bus Rapid Transit corridor has a segregated bus lane.
exercises.zh: 新的巴士快速交通走廊設有分隔式專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The new Bus Rapid Transit corridor has a segregated BRT lane.

options.explanation: 可概括，但題目明確是 BRT 系統，BRT lane 更精準。
Bus Rapid Transit + segregated lane 直接對應。

exercises.original: Stations are built beside the dedicated lanes used by the rapid bus service.
exercises.zh: 車站建於快速巴士服務專用線旁。
exercises.upgrade: Stations are built beside the dedicated BRT lanes used by the rapid bus service.

options.explanation: 題目說的是 stations beside lanes，不能把 lane 本身改成 stop。
rapid bus service + dedicated lanes + station layout 都是 BRT 特徵。

words.example: The city converted the curbside lane into a bus lane.
words.exampleZh: 市政府把路旁車道改成巴士專用線。

exercises.original: The bus lane runs beside the pavement on the left side of the street.
exercises.zh: 巴士專用線沿行人路旁、位於街道左側。
exercises.upgrade: The curbside bus lane runs beside the pavement on the left side of the street.

options.explanation: beside the pavement/kerb 是決定性位置線索。
位於道路中央，和 beside the pavement 相反。
重點是逆向，不是路旁位置。

exercises.original: The city converted the lane next to the kerb into a bus lane.
exercises.zh: 市政府把路緣旁的車道改成巴士專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The city converted the kerbside bus lane area into a dedicated public-transport space.

options.explanation: 指道路中央，與 next to the kerb 不符。
英式拼寫中 kerbside 正好指路緣旁位置。

exercises.original: Buses pick up passengers directly beside the bus lane at the pavement edge.
exercises.zh: 巴士在行人路邊的巴士專用線旁直接上落客。
exercises.upgrade: Buses pick up passengers directly beside the curbside bus lane at the pavement edge.

options.explanation: 通常配中央月台，不是 pavement edge。
pavement edge + roadside boarding 明確是路旁巴士線。
題目沒有快速巴士系統線索。

words.example: The avenue uses median bus lanes with central boarding platforms.
words.exampleZh: 大道設有中央巴士專用線及中央上落客月台。

exercises.original: The bus lanes run in the centre of the avenue beside central platforms.
exercises.zh: 巴士專用線位於大道中央、中央月台旁。
exercises.upgrade: The median bus lanes run in the centre of the avenue beside central platforms.

options.explanation: 應位於路緣旁，與 centre/central platforms 不符。
道路中央＋中央月台是典型 median-running 配置。

exercises.original: Passengers reach the bus lane by crossing to an island platform in the middle of the road.
exercises.zh: 乘客要過馬路到中央安全島月台乘搭巴士。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers reach the median bus lane by crossing to an island platform in the middle of the road.

options.explanation: 乘客毋須前往道路中央。
island platform in the middle 是明確中央車道配置。
題目要的是 lane 類型，不只是站點。

exercises.original: The BRT system uses centre-running bus lanes.
exercises.zh: 巴士快速交通系統採用中央行車式巴士專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The BRT system uses median bus lanes.

options.explanation: route 不表示 centre-running 車道配置。
centre-running 就是位於道路中央的 lane。

words.example: A contraflow bus lane lets buses travel in both directions on the one-way street.
words.exampleZh: 逆向巴士專用線讓巴士可在單程街道上雙向通行。

exercises.original: Buses travel against the direction of general traffic in the special lane.
exercises.zh: 巴士在專用線內逆向於一般車流行駛。
exercises.upgrade: Buses travel in a contraflow bus lane against the direction of general traffic.

options.explanation: against the direction of general traffic 是直接定義。
只表示位置在中央，不表示逆向。

exercises.original: The one-way street has a bus lane running in the opposite direction.
exercises.zh: 這條單程街道設有一條逆向巴士專用線。
exercises.upgrade: The one-way street has a contraflow bus lane running in the opposite direction.

options.explanation: 只說巴士專用，未指出 opposite direction。
one-way street + opposite direction 是典型逆向巴士線。

exercises.original: The scheme lets buses travel both ways on a street that is one-way for other vehicles.
exercises.zh: 計劃讓巴士在其他車輛只能單向行駛的街道上雙向通行。
exercises.upgrade: The scheme uses a contraflow bus lane so buses can travel both ways on the one-way street.

options.explanation: 只表示保留使用，不能解釋為何可逆向。
讓巴士在單程街道逆向通行，語義最精準。

falseSynonyms.zh: 專用巴士路線不等於 bus lane route 是巴士行駛的整條路線或服務走向；lane 是道路上的一條車道。你提供的這個表達與 bus lanes 相關，但不是直接同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A bus route describes where a service goes; a bus lane describes road space reserved or prioritised for buses.

falseSynonyms.zh: 巴士路線不等於巴士專用線 bus route 可以完全行駛在一般混合交通中；bus lane 是道路空間安排。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A bus route may use bus lanes, but the route itself is not a lane.

falseSynonyms.zh: 巴士站不等於 bus lane bus stop 是巴士上落客的地點；bus lane 是供巴士行駛的車道。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A bus stop is a stopping point; a bus lane is a traffic lane.

falseSynonyms.zh: 高載客車輛線不等於巴士專用線 HOV lane 通常容許載有指定乘客人數的私家車和其他車輛，並不只供巴士。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Buses may use an HOV lane, but an HOV lane is not necessarily a bus-only lane.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單車徑／單車線不等於巴士線 cycle lane 是供單車使用的道路空間，交通功能不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cycle lane is reserved for bicycles, not buses.

falseSynonyms.zh: 的士線不等於巴士線 某些公共交通線可能允許的士，但 taxi lane 和 bus lane 不能視為同義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A lane for taxis serves a different vehicle class from a bus lane.

falseSynonyms.zh: 路肩不等於 bus lane 部分地區在繁忙時段會讓巴士使用路肩，但 shoulder 本身不是巴士專用線。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A road shoulder may sometimes be opened to buses, but it is not inherently a bus lane.

falseSynonyms.zh: 公共交通走廊不等於單一車道 transit corridor 可以涵蓋整條道路、路線、車站和交通基建；bus lane 只是其中一種設施。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A transit corridor is broader than a single bus lane.
